Promotion uses the later 30% of those pools, a held-out set of pools, a 3-window walk-forward of the frozen parameters, and a check that a neighbouring configuration also has positive out-of-sample expectancy. GeckoTerminal does not publish historical pool reserves or a historical new-pool archive on the keyless API (pages past 10 return 401; new_pools is only the last few minutes, checked 2026-11-09). Liquidity in the primary result is the spot snapshot. The thin cohort is low spot liquidity with age of at least a few hours, which is the closest free sample of failed launches, not a point-in-time listing from months ago. 5-minute and 1-minute results are reported for the frozen 15-minute champion and are not used to pick it. The number of configurations tried is the size of the pre-registered grid.
